Draft on the API, reviewer checks before delivery (two proof orders)

validation.proof: by day 18: >= 2 cleared payments >= $1,250 from 2 distinct payers, and the first plan approved in writing by its attorney
stop: day 0: no reviewer quote <= $90 incl. 2 re-checks -> do not start outreach; the plan is NO_PLAN for fulfilment
day 18: 0 cleared payments and < 3 intake requests from 800 firms -> stop; at most $292 spent
continue: day 18 proof met -> release up to $1,708 for fulfilment of further orders at <= $140 each (API, review, re-run, fee) and outreach to 700 more firms; $10,000 needs 8 cleared orders by day 30 (6 after proof)
day 18: 1 cleared payment, or 0 with >= 3 intake requests -> revise once ($995 pilot for firms with >= 2 E-2 cases a year) inside the remaining $8 of pre-proof allowance; re-decide on day 25

answers.resolution: stop now keyed to the 800 firms actually contacted, plus a day-0 supplier stop
every day-18 outcome maps to stop, revise-once or continue; continue is gated on proof itself
the check now counts spending on the proof day as pre-proof; proof day moved to 18 so ACH clears before it counts
re-run costed at the $15 draft cost; one round committed per order before proof, the second only after proof; reviewer ceiling lowered to $90
step s0 obtains the written quote before any outreach; no quote -> stop
engagement terms: 2 rounds in 30 days, written approval or rejection within 5 business days, rejection = no charge (cost already spent and counted)
approval time is UNKNOWN and bounded by the 5-business-day term; day 0 = first authorized execution day
